nodes.label: Drag Offset Positioning
nodes.rationale: Captures the cursor-to-item offset and converts coordinates with canvas scale so dragged items remain under the cursor.

nodes.label: useKV Layout Persistence
nodes.rationale: Persists named custom layouts across sessions.

nodes.label: Bounded Undo/Redo History
nodes.rationale: Limits history to 50 deep-cloned states to prevent memory growth and reference aliasing.

nodes.label: Global Mouse Resize Listeners
nodes.rationale: Registers document-level mouse listeners only during resizing to provide smooth interaction while limiting listener overhead.

nodes.label: State Persistence
nodes.rationale: Automatically preserves themes, requirements, and layouts across sessions while keeping uploaded semantic-model files session-only.

nodes.label: Rule-Based Optimization Fallback
nodes.rationale: Maintains usable layout optimization when the language-model call fails.
